rules.title: Application Screening Fee Limits
rules.requirement: Landlords may charge an application screening fee no greater than the actual out-of-pocket costs of gathering information and reasonable value of time spent, up to a maximum of thirty dollars ($30) per applicant, which may be adjusted annually by the Consumer Price Index beginning January 1, 1998.

coverage.summary: Applies to residential rental property applicants.

rules.quoted_span: In no case shall the amount of the application screening fee charged by the landlord or their agent be greater than thirty dollars ($30) per applicant. The thirty dollar ($30) application screening fee may be adjusted annually by the landlord or their agent commensurate with an increase in the Consumer Price Index, beginning on January 1, 1998.
